title: Basic List Index Error
expected_tutor_behaviour: Identify the index out of bounds without providing the corrected code.
expected_socratic_objective: Prompt the student to count the elements in the list and compare to the index 10.

title: Dictionary KeyError
expected_tutor_behaviour: Acknowledge the missing key. Avoid writing the .get() method directly.
expected_socratic_objective: Ask the student how they can check if a key exists before accessing it, or ask what happens when a key is missing.

title: Infinite While Loop
expected_tutor_behaviour: Identify that the loop variable is never updated, causing an infinite loop.
expected_socratic_objective: Ask the student what happens to the value of 'count' inside the loop.
